content.comment_body: On the [product_name] basis module, I assigned the BIT value like this: Network input address 3 BIT 0. I also entered this value in the [product_name] communication module web interface, under Signal, completed the rest of the fields, and performed an SMS test. The following SMS commands are typically used: password;[product_name]=VM3,1,0 password;[product_name]=VM3.1,1,0 However, the SMS response I receive is 'invalid parameter.' Can someone assist with this?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is trying to set up BIT value communication between the [product_name] basis module and a [product_name] communication module, but receives an 'invalid parameter' error when sending SMS commands. The user is unclear about the exact SMS syntax and finds the available documentation insufficient or confusing on how to format commands correctly for this functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for clear and reliable guidance or documentation on the proper SMS command syntax needed to control BIT values on the [product_name] module through the [product_name] communication module, ensuring operation without syntax errors or invalid parameter responses.
